description: Deep wallet profile for x402 payer intelligence — pass ?address=0x… (GET) or {"address":"0x…"} (POST) and get ETH+USDC balances on Base, transaction count, contract detection, and the last ~50 minutes of USDC payment flows: how many payments the wallet made, to how many distinct payees, top counterparties by volume, and incoming funding. Classifies the wallet (x402_sweeper_eoa / agent_eoa_usdc_only / active_eoa / contract) from the observed autonomous-agent payer population.
name: akari_deep
